surfaceSource.notes: Permanent G1 max9 rows, G2 max10 rows. One continuous bank each with 0.4m estimated riser (0.3–0.5m plausible range); front base2.2m and eye1.2m retained. Existing coarse terrain datum sampled at each complete bank. Source-driven reduction of former separately guessed ramps, not height optimized for sightline clearance.

geometryReview.method: Two permanent source banks reconstructed from paired OSM strips plus interposed aisle; complete outer envelope retains source points. Must pass full rendered road and other-object clearance. No visibility-based boundary reduction.

terrainProfileReview.method: Organizer aerial shows unroofed, ground-supported terraces rather than a2.2m elevated box. Use original front-strip road-side edge and rear-strip uphill edge midpoints as independent GSI terrain anchors. Retain all footprint vertices and row counts. Uniform row levels interpolate the sampled bank relief, not a fixed0.4m per-row guess. No eye, car or sightline result is used to fit these anchors.
terrainProfileReview.limitation: 0.1m floor clearance is a schematic slab allowance, not a measured bench/foundation. GSI5m/10m interpolation cannot resolve individual steps or the precise walkway. Full2026 inventory and exact row floors remain uncertified.

previousBankMethods.g-overpass: Conservative outer convex envelope of both unmodified adjacent OSM strips, including the intervening aisle and end taper. All source vertices retained inside; no shift, rotation or raycast-based clipping. Usable-seat boundary remains approximate, with aisle/platform space included.
